# Subsetix Kokkos Overview

Subsetix Kokkos is a C++20 library for finite volume discretization on sparse adaptive geometries.

## What is Subsetix Kokkos?

Subsetix Kokkos provides:

- **Sparse domain representation** using CSR interval sets
- **Parallel execution** via Kokkos (Serial, OpenMP, CUDA)
- **Adaptive mesh refinement** (AMR) capabilities
- **Finite volume methods** for hyperbolic PDEs

## Use Cases

- **Computational fluid dynamics** on complex geometries
- **AMR simulations** with dynamic refinement
- **GPU-accelerated** finite volume methods
- **Sparse domain problems** in 2D/3D

## Project Structure

```
include/subsetix/
├── geometry/        # CSR interval set representation
├── field/           # Fields on CSR geometries
├── csr_ops/         # Parallel kernels
├── multilevel/      # AMR support
├── io/              # VTK export
└── fvd/             # Finite Volume Discretization layer
```
